replacements.new: - [x] Define an architecture-neutral generator of behavioral specifications. — ✅ PR #959 / #957: every semantically valid registered ecology maps to a finite external probe/response relation, exact score, and explicit resource terms; generation and scoring expose no implementation-family input.

- [x] Define systematic environment/ecology families. — ✅ PR #959 / #957: a typed Cartesian-product iterator covers all 131,072 members of the 17-axis registered family exactly once; iterator, recursive, arithmetic, and unique-rank counts agree.
- [x] Vary observability. — ✅ PR #959 / #957: a two-state observation partition has aliased and separating levels, with state-pair distinguishability computed from partition membership.
- [x] Vary recurrence. — ✅ PR #959 / #957: acyclic and cyclic transition graphs are distinguished by an independent directed-cycle test.
- [x] Vary uncertainty/noise. — ✅ PR #959 / #957: multi-outcome and single-positive-support transition laws vary uncertainty, with support size derived from integer weights.

- [x] Vary causal ambiguity/intervention access. — ✅ PR #959 / #957: observationally aliased causes are paired with absent versus present intervention access, tested from the external cause/interface tables.
- [x] Vary compositional structure. — ✅ PR #959 / #957: monolithic and two-factor payloads vary whether disjoint component scopes cover the external variables.
- [x] Vary spatial/locality structure. — ✅ PR #959 / #957: influence edges outside versus inside a registered radius provide a nondegenerate locality witness.
- [x] Vary symmetry/equivariance. — ✅ PR #959 / #957: asymmetric and swap-invariant outcome tables are evaluated under an explicit nonidentity permutation.
- [x] Vary communication topology. — ✅ PR #959 / #957: disconnected and connected directed communication graphs vary required sender-to-receiver reachability.
- [x] Vary multi-agent competition/cooperation. — ✅ PR #959 / #957: opposed versus aligned payoff tables vary whether agents share an optimal joint choice.
- [x] Vary verification availability/cost. — ✅ PR #959 / #957: verification prices above versus within an explicit budget give an exact affordability boundary.
- [x] Vary memory price. — ✅ PR #959 / #957: required memory expenditure is varied across a fixed budget boundary.
- [x] Vary compute price. — ✅ PR #959 / #957: required compute expenditure is varied across a fixed budget boundary.
- [x] Vary communication price. — ✅ PR #959 / #957: required communication expenditure is varied across a fixed budget boundary.
- [x] Vary energy price. — ✅ PR #959 / #957: required energy expenditure is varied across a fixed budget boundary.
- [x] Vary developmental horizon. — ✅ PR #959 / #957: available developmental steps below versus at a fixed required sequence length vary horizon feasibility.
- [x] Vary nonstationarity/drift. — ✅ PR #959 / #957: changing versus stable cross-epoch calibration targets provide an explicit drift witness.
- [x] Vary embodiment/sensor-action constraints. — ✅ PR #959 / #957: unavailable versus available required sensor-action pairs vary the external embodied interface.

- [x] Construct matched positive/negative ecology twins. — ✅ PR #959 / #957: all 17 axes have isolated twins differing in exactly one coordinate and semantic payload, with exactly the corresponding behavioral target flipping from 0 to 1.
